description: Canonical index of original first-party authored skill packages. Separate from discovered third-party inventory, static review counts, and installation approvals.
default_license_scope: Repository-owned original material only; third-party or separately licensed components retain their own terms. See each record for overrides.
license_policy: All newly authored skills require an explicit SPDX license ID, publisher/rightsholder, license evidence path, exact source fingerprint, complete package tree and rights review. Default MIT is permissive, not a no-cost guarantee or share-alike license.

skills.license_inheritance: Root repository MIT covers original content in this package; no third-party protected source incorporated.
skills.rights_note: Independent MIT-authored package with public README, exact-quote clause scrutiny cards and fictional fixtures; no third-party skill text or real PHI copied. Source comparisons at docs/reviews/2026-11-06-issue714-package-candidate-comparison.md.
